title: Hurley's Saturday rehearsal
summary: Hurley's opens at 8 a.m. for a morning program.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Well, I remember about that time there
was a morning program called TeaTimer's program. You didn't do that, I think Chubby --

They used to have an 8:00 o'clock rehearsal Saturday morning, and they used to open Hurley's Bar especially for that. All the musicians would go and have whiskey sours. And my wife said, you know, this has got to be the only profession in the world where you can walk in a bar at 8:00 in the morning and see 10 musicians, 10 of your business associates lined up there.
They had great ham and eggs in Hurley's, that's one thing I remember. They had some real mean people there, but good ham and eggs. But we were talking about that last time, how unpopular --
Yeah, it's kind of a lady's cafeteria or something or other now.
